places.name: Arthouse Hotel
places.description: Arthouse Hotel is a Boutique Hotel on the Upper West Side, and the hotel says our century-old building retains many of its historic accents. Rooms start at approximately 240 square feet, there are three on-site restaurants and bars, and the Natural History Museum sits a mere two blocks away from our property. Tripadvisor rates it 4.2 Good (8,181) and its summary finds it favorably located near Central Park and the subway. Honest watch-outs from the same summary: guests flag the music too loud, experiences with housekeeping and room size vary, and some travelers feel the hotel is overpriced with limited amenities.

places.name: Hilton Club New York
places.description: Run by Hilton Grand Vacations, Hilton Club New York offers stylish Studios and spacious Suites with skyline views, located in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, so Fifth Avenue, Rockefeller Center and Broadway are a walk away. Tripadvisor travelers give it 4.3 of 5 bubbles (940 reviews). Guest feedback is warm on rooms, which feel calm and well kept, and cooler on extras: there is no room service, breakfast costs more than many expect, and one stay started with an air-conditioning leak, so inspect the room early.

places.name: Hotel Beacon
places.description: Hotel Beacon is a 24-story building on the Upper West Side of Manhattan. It was built in 1928 at 2130 Broadway, at 75th Street, beside the Beacon Theatre and a short walk from Central Park, Riverside Park and Zabar's. Tripadvisor travelers rate it 4.5 of 5 bubbles (5,535 reviews). Guests single out the staff's professionalism, generous rooms for a longer stay and striking views; the honest caveat is age, as parts of the hotel look their years even though hygiene and service stay excellent.
places.address: Upper West Side, New York, NY

places.name: Hotel Edison
places.description: Hotel Edison is a historic, art deco hotel in the Theatre District, steps from Times Square, at 228 West 47th Street. Tripadvisor scores it 3.9 Good (18,818), typical of a busy, high-volume landmark. Reviews praise room size and cleanliness for the location and suggest eating along Eighth Avenue for more choice. The recurring complaint is noise: some guests lost sleep over several nights, so earplugs or a quieter room request are sensible.
places.address: Times Square / Theater District, New York, NY

places.name: Hotel Lucerne
places.description: Hotel Lucerne stands at 201 WEST 79TH STREET, NEW YORK, NY 10024, a short walk from the American Museum of Natural History and Central Park. Its ground-floor French bistro invites guests to Dine At Nice Matin, a neighborhood brunch favorite. Tripadvisor travelers give it 4.4 of 5 bubbles (3,589 reviews). Guests praise clean beds, practical bathrooms and a restful stay; the watch-outs are dated decor and two older elevators that can mean a wait at busy times.

places.name: Hyatt Grand Central New York
places.description: Hyatt Grand Central New York, the hotel located at 109 East 42nd Street, stands adjoining Grand Central Terminal, which makes rail day trips and subway hops effortless. Trip.com shows 7.9 / 10 Good 207 reviews, and guests say it is right next to Grand Central Station, making it super convenient for getting around. Rooms are described as spacious and the fitness center as thoughtfully stocked. The honest watch-out is that the staff were very impatient when answering the phone, so handle requests at the desk.

places.name: Hyatt House New York/Chelsea
places.description: Hyatt House New York/Chelsea 815 Avenue of the Americas is built for longer stays, with Kitchen Suites, a 24/7 H Market, a 24/7 Fitness Room and Pet-friendly accommodations. Trip.com guests rate it 8.4 / 10 Very good 121 reviews and say Love the breakfast. All the staffs are friendly. The fridges, dishwashers and irons help families settle in. Watch-outs: housekeeping tends to arrive late in the afternoon, and one guest writes I wish there were more vegetables for breakfast.

places.name: Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square
places.description: At Motto by Hilton New York City Times Square, Hilton says Motto New York City Times Square will entice guests looking for connection and efficiency, with Guest rooms designed with an intentional footprint. Trip.com guests rate it 8.6 / 10 Very good 729 reviews, calling it Affordable and clean, you get what you pay for in New York and noting The front desk staff were also very nice. The honest trade-off is space: Rooms are super small.
places.address: 150 A West 48th Street, New York, NY 10036

places.name: New York Marriott Downtown
places.description: The hotel sits at 85 West Street at Albany Street, New York, New York, USA, 10006, close to the Statue of Liberty ferries. Its dining story is the New York Marriott Downtown – home to Bill’s Bar & Burger, renowned for serving some of the best burgers in the country, plus a bar with live music, inventive cocktails and a selection of regional beers. Trip.com shows 8.6 / 10 Very good 342 reviews; guests write Safe and good location. Loved the great river view and is very clean. The main caveat: The room was tiny, and the bed was also very small in some categories.

places.name: New York Marriott Marquis
places.description: New York Marriott Marquis is the giant Marriott hotel on Times Square, with the Marquis Theatre built into the property and Broadway on every side. Trip.com guests rate it 8.9 / 10 Very good 655 reviews and say The hotel has a fantastic location and the rooms are very clean. Breakfast is called a bargain add-on, and the cheesecake and avocado salad get recommended. Honest watch-outs: it can get a bit noisy at night, and the hotel charges a mandatory $40 daily fee.

places.name: Night Hotel Broadway
places.description: Night Hotel Broadway is a Hotel on the Upper West Side, New York City, on Broadway with Riverside Park and Central Park nearby. Trip.com shows 6.7 / 10 64 reviews. Guests say The location is outstanding, just 2-3 minutes from 96th Street and appreciate that the staff cleans and makes the beds every day. Renovated rooms in quiet positions earn the best feedback; the watch-out is that the hotel is somewhat out dated elsewhere, so choose an updated room category.

places.name: Park Central Hotel New York
places.description: Park Central Hotel New York is a large hotel located southwest of Carnegie Hall at 870 7th Avenue, between West 55th and 56th streets, a few blocks from Central Park and the Theater District. Trip.com guests rate it 8.0 / 10 Very good 185 reviews and say The hotel's biggest advantage is its incredibly convenient location. Reviews praise value and diligent room service. Honest watch-outs: The room amenities are basic, and My room faced the street, which was a bit noisy, so request an inner room.
places.address: Midtown / Central Park South, New York, NY

places.name: Pod Times Square
places.description: Pod Times Square is an affordable Midtown NYC hotel with smart rooms, free Wi-Fi, walking tours and a prime location near Broadway, at 400 W 42nd St on the far west side of Times Square. Guests write The location is fantastic! and The room was cleaned daily at 10 AM and was very tidy, and the front desk wins praise for luggage storage and a lounge for waiting. Watch-outs: The room was a little small, and there's a nightly resort fee of $29.84 collected at the front desk.
places.address: Hell’s Kitchen / Times Square, New York, NY

places.name: Romer Hell's Kitchen
places.description: Romer Hell's Kitchen sits at 851 Eighth Ave. New York City, New York 10019; The 295-guestroom hotel took over a former Hampton Inn and now promises you just might feel like you wandered into a local legend's living room. Guestrooms measure up to 600 square feet, and evenings center on So & So's, with nightly live entertainment where anybody just might drop in. Guests describe a great location, easy walk to Times Square, Theater District, MOMA, and 5th Avenue, and say The beds were super comfortable and the bathroom was modern and Our room was quiet and well soundproofed. The watch-out is bathrooms: The bathroom was too cramped for some, and The bathrooms were fairly tiny.

places.name: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel
places.description: Sheraton New York Times Square Hotel is a 51-story hotel located near Times Square on Seventh Avenue, a convention-scale property with many room types for groups. Trip.com guests rate it 7.8 / 10 Good 158 reviews and report Room is great and clean, plus front-desk staff who go out of their way. Honest watch-outs: room quality is described as so-so by some, parking costs a lot, and one guest adds I expected a sauna/Spa as it is listed under amenities.

places.name: The Empire Hotel New York
places.description: The Empire Hotel New York sits steps from Lincoln Center & Central Park and offers Stylish Art Deco rooms and a vibrant rooftop bar that is a draw on its own. Trip.com guests rate it 7.8 / 10 Good 112 reviews and say Staff was generally quite nice, with fast, friendly check-in. Honest watch-outs: the hotel is quite old, and some rooms are tiny with old fashioned floor air conditioner which was very loud.

places.name: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel
places.description: The Manhattan at Times Square Hotel now trades as Crowne Plaza Manhattan Times Square - formerly The Manhattan at Times Square, so look for the IHG name. Trip.com shows 6.4 / 10 245 reviews. Guests agree The location of the hotel is great and right in the middle of it all and that a discounted rate makes it worthwhile. The serious watch-outs: There was constant, loud renovation noise from upstairs next door, and one guest reports The room's hygiene was terrible, so inspect the room at check-in.

places.name: Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collection
places.description: Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collection stands at 299 Madison Ave, at E.41st Street New York City 10017, and its story is literary: guests get Access to our collection of over 6,000 books, with refreshments available 24 hours a day in our Reading Room. Trip.com shows 9.3 / 10 Great 103 reviews, and guests say The hotel has a great location and good service. The honest note is that the facilities are old, which most guests accept for the charm.

places.name: The Wallace Hotel
places.description: The Wallace Hotel offers the ultimate luxury and sophistication on the Upper West Side of New York City, a short walk from Lincoln Center, Central Park and the Broadway subway lines. It is new (Clean, nice spot. Opened in 2020), and guests say The room was very spacious, and the bed was super comfortable. The location gets praise for calm streets and many restaurants nearby. Watch-out: one guest found It was noisy continuously throughout the night, so ask for a quiet room.

place:602.title: Zabar's
place:602.summary: Zabar's is the Upper West Side food store at 2245 Broadway at 80th Street, open every day. Zabar's is open 365 days a year, so it works on any day of the trip for smoked fish, bagels, coffee and a Central Park picnic.
place:602.longDetails: Zabar's is a landmark Upper West Side food store at 2245 Broadway at 80th Street. Its directions page says the store is open 365 days a year. It is a good stop for smoked fish, bagels, coffee and picnic supplies before a walk in Central Park. On Yelp, Zabar's holds a 3.9 rating from about 1,400 reviews.
place:602.itineraryNote: Zabar's: the Upper West Side food hall at 2245 Broadway at 80th Street; browse the smoked fish counter and grab picnic supplies for Riverside Park.
place:602.websiteFlavour: Family-owned gourmet emporium since 1934 at 80th & Broadway; specializes in hand-sliced smoked fish, artisanal cheeses from around the world, custom-roasted coffees (e.g., Special Blend, Z-Peat), fresh-baked bagels, babka, rugelach; deli classics like pastrami; extensive kitchenware/housewares upstairs; cafe; gift baskets and online shopping for iconic NYC treats.
place:602.review1: Zabar's is treated as an essential Upper West Side food stop, with shoppers praising the smoked fish counter and extras like bread pudding and the cafe.
place:602.review2: Shoppers describe it as a busy neighborhood institution, especially on mornings, with a deep range of Jewish deli and breakfast foods and generally good service.
place:602.review3: Visitors often call it an underrated find, comparing it favorably with big chain grocers for selection and finding prices fair for Manhattan.
place:602.review4: The baked goods and coffee are a verdict highlight, with chocolate babka, rugelach and the house blend coffee among the most recommended buys.
place:602.details: Google lists Zabar's around 4.5/5. Iconic UWS specialty market and prepared-foods stop; useful for breakfast supplies, picnic items, coffee, smoked fish, and take-home food gifts. Expect crowds at peak times. Price: $18 per person picnic-supplies planning estimate.
